Docs.param: The name of the voice agent to connect to (used as the {agentName} path segment).
Additional connection options. Use to select a Voice Agent transport, or to pass Foundry's "store" option as "store=true" or "store=false".
Docs.summary:
Starts and connects a realtime session for the named voice agent. Overrides
rather than introducing a differently-named method: this is the public, documented way to start a voice-agent session -- get a from , then call this (inherited/overridden) method on it, the same way an OpenAI consumer would.
Docs.returns: An already-connected (returned as the base type: Task<T> isn't covariant in T even under C# 9+ override covariance, unlike a method's own direct return type).
Docs.exception: The selected transport has no value.
